judge_reasoning: The model's plan illegally attacks with Angel of Invention and two newly-created Servo tokens, all of which have summoning sickness (no haste) and cannot attack the turn they enter the battlefield. Once these illegal attackers are removed, only 3 creatures (Cutthroat, Aristocrat, Sacred Cat) can attack. The opponent has exactly 3 blockers, and while skulk guarantees Cutthroat is unblocked, the opponent can block both remaining attackers, limiting damage to just 2 (Cutthroat only), leaving the opponent at 1 life instead of the required ≤0. Since the rest of the plan (sacrificing creatures to Ayli, then exiling Gideon) only removes protection but deals no additional damage, exiling Gideon would not cause the opponent to lose if their life is still positive. The solution therefore fails to guarantee victory against a reasonable/optimal blocking decision by the opponent, unlike the official solution's trick of pumping power after blocks are locked in.
model_solution:
1. Cast Angel of Invention (tap 2 Plains + 3 Swamps), choosing Fabricate 2 to create two 1/1 Servo tokens. Other creatures get +1/+1: Vampire Cutthroat 2/2, Indulgent Aristocrat 2/2, Sacred Cat 2/2, both Servos 2/2, Ayli 3/4.
2. Attack with Vampire Cutthroat, Indulgent Aristocrat, Sacred Cat, Angel of Invention, and both Servos (6 attackers). Ayli stays home (its damage is prevented anyway).
   - Cutthroat (skulk, power 2) can't be blocked by any of the opponent's creatures (all have power >2): 2 damage guaranteed.
   - Opponent has only 3 potential blockers for the other 5 attackers, so at least 2 more 2-power attackers connect. Total combat damage to the opponent is at least 6, putting them at -3 or lower (they don't lose yet due to the emblem).
   - Lifelink: Cutthroat, Aristocrat, Sacred Cat, and Angel each deal their 2 damage to either the opponent or a blocker, so I gain exactly 8 life regardless of blocks: 21 → 29.
3. Postcombat main phase (5 lands untapped): Activate Ayli's first ability ({1}, tap a Swamp), sacrificing a surviving creature (at least 3 of the 6 attackers survive since at most 3 can be blocked). Gain at least 1 life (toughness ≥1) → at least 30 life. (If for some reason still short, one more spare land allows a second {1} sacrifice.)
4. With ≥30 life (at least 10 more than starting life), activate Ayli's second ability ({1}{W}{B}: Plains, Plains, Swamp), sacrificing another creature, targeting Gideon of the Trials. Gideon is exiled.
5. The opponent no longer controls a Gideon planeswalker, so the emblem no longer protects them. State-based actions see their life total at 0 or less, and they lose the game.
